function.description: Book the appointment. Call this only after the caller has chosen a specific time you offered AND you have asked the medical screening question. Pass the slot id exactly as checkAvailability gave it. If they disclosed anything medical, do not call this — call flagMedicalHold and escalate.
function.name: createBooking

firstName.description: Caller first name as they said it. Do not ask for a surname unless they offer one.

medicalScreenPassed.description: Set true ONLY after asking the screening question and hearing a clear no. If they said yes, are unsure, or you did not ask, set false and call flagMedicalHold instead of booking.

notes.description: Scheduling preferences only, e.g. "prefers a quieter room". NEVER any health, medical, or diagnostic detail.

slotId.description: Slot id exactly as checkAvailability returned it, e.g. hold-7K2. Never invent one.

messages.content: Let me get that booked for you.
I'm having trouble completing that booking.
